stage: STAGE F (PRODUCTION PERFORMANCE, FIVE-PLATFORM DELIVERY & INDEPENDENT CERTIFICATION)

defects.name: Car Steering Sign Inversion & Camera Yaw Offset
defects.symptom: Pressing KeyA turns the car rightwards or pans the camera opposite to vehicle deflection; initial road spawn orientation misaligned by 90 degrees.

flow_tracing.geographic_collision: apps/world-viewer/src/interactive.rs:1290 (spawn yaw atan2(dx, dz) produces 90-degree frame shift relative to camera atan2(dz, dx))
flow_tracing.rendering: engine/rendering/src/gltf_asset.rs:372 & vehicle_mesh.rs:250 (sign discrepancy between wheel mesh rotation and steering wheel Quat::from_rotation_z(-steer * 3.5))
flow_tracing.hud: engine/rendering/src/hud.rs:3421 (STEER: -24 deg vs inverted visual steering)

defects.verified_root_cause: 1. In interactive.rs:1290, road tangent heading uses atan2(dx, dz) instead of atan2(dz, dx), creating a pi/2 (90-degree) angular misalignment between road geometry and camera frame. 2. In camera.rs:111, steer_lookahead = car_right * (steer_angle * 1.5) pulls camera lookahead left, shifting car to the right of the viewport.
defects.remediation_strategy: Align road heading calculation to atan2(dz, dx) matching camera controller, correct steering wheel rotation signs, and tune steer lookahead vector.

defects.name: Self-Steering Lateral Divergence Under Zero Input
defects.symptom: Vehicle drifts laterally and self-steers when moving in reverse down slopes with hands off steering (zero steer input).

flow_tracing.simulation: engine/vehicles/src/dynamics.rs:491-495 (Tire slip angle formula uses abs(v_forward); lacking pneumatic trail and caster angle, front wheels at +Z act as trailing casters without restoring moment)
flow_tracing.geographic_collision: engine/vehicles/src/ground.rs:60 (Sloped ground surface normal pushes vehicle backward)
flow_tracing.rendering: Vehicle yaw rotates continuously away from tangent

defects.verified_root_cause: Tire slip angle calculation in dynamics.rs:491 uses (v_lateral / v_forward.abs()).atan(). When moving in reverse (v_forward < 0), front wheels lack caster self-aligning mechanical trail, creating positive feedback yaw divergence that induces self-steering.
defects.remediation_strategy: Incorporate pneumatic trail and signed caster angle restoring torque in dynamics.rs to stabilize reverse wheel slip.

defects.name: Backward Drift on Slope With Zero Input in Drive (D1)
defects.symptom: Vehicle rolls backwards down realistic hill slopes (e.g. San Francisco 8% grade) while transmission is in Drive with zero throttle/brake input; pressing W then triggers reverse service braking instead of forward motion.

flow_tracing.simulation: engine/vehicles/src/dynamics.rs:739 (is_flat_idle requires slope_grade < 0.025; fails on 8% grade, allowing gravity to accelerate car backwards)
flow_tracing.geographic_collision: Normal force component along slope pushes vehicle along -Z
flow_tracing.rendering: Vehicle moves backwards down hill while gear indicator shows D1
flow_tracing.hud: apps/world-viewer/src/interactive.rs:4674 (active_forward_speed < -0.3 causes pressing W to apply brake = 0.95 and force gear_mode = Reverse)

defects.verified_root_cause: Absence of automatic transmission hill-hold / torque converter creep in Drive mode. dynamics.rs:739 disables static friction hold when slope_grade >= 0.025, permitting gravitational rollback. interactive.rs:4674 then mistakenly treats forward throttle (W) as reverse braking when rolling backwards.
defects.remediation_strategy: Add idle creep and automatic hill-hold logic in Drive mode, and decouple forward key input (W) from reverse brake switching.

defects.name: Building Collision Inward Penetration Trapping
defects.symptom: When a vehicle penetrates slightly into a building footprint polygon, collision resolution pushes it deeper inside rather than ejecting it to the street.

flow_tracing.geographic_collision: diff = p - closest edge. When p is inside polygon, diff points inward from edge to center. best_normal is set to diff / d (pointing inward), and pos += normal * depth pushes vehicle deeper inside
flow_tracing.rendering: Vehicle trapped inside opaque building geometry
flow_tracing.hud: Collision sound loops, speed drops to 0

defects.verified_root_cause: In building_collision.rs:24-29, the collision normal is calculated as (p - closest). When the vehicle point p penetrates the building, (p - closest) points from the exterior edge toward the building interior, causing pos += normal * depth to drive the vehicle deeper into the building geometry.
defects.remediation_strategy: Invert normal when inside polygon using point-in-polygon test, ensuring collision normal always points outward toward street exterior.

defects.name: Placeholder Fallback Meshes & Heavy Truck Viewport Occlusion
defects.symptom: Heavy truck articulated trailer completely blocks the third-person camera viewport; runtime models use procedural fallback boxes instead of glTF models.

flow_tracing.geographic_collision: Truck chassis + trailer bounding box (17.5m total length)
flow_tracing.rendering: engine/rendering/src/vehicle_models.rs:3426 generates procedural boxes; camera chase distance is set to 18.0m, leaving only 1.95m clearance to rear trailer wall
flow_tracing.hud: Heavy haul telemetry visible, but screen center is 90% occluded by grey trailer wall

defects.verified_root_cause: 1. Vehicle 3D GLB assets in assets/vehicles/ are not loaded or bound at runtime; rendering falls back to procedural primitive boxes in vehicle_models.rs. 2. Heavy truck camera anchors define chase_distance = 18.0m while trailer extends 15.0m rearward, placing the camera within 1.95m of the tall trailer back wall.
defects.remediation_strategy: Bind certified glTF vehicle models and adjust Heavy Truck camera chase distance to >= 24.0m with elevated chase height.

defects.name: Train Simulation Free Roam Without Track Geometry
defects.symptom: Locomotive and railcars accelerate and drive over roads, hills, and dirt terrain when no rail graph is loaded, acting like an off-road vehicle.

flow_tracing.simulation: apps/world-viewer/src/interactive.rs:4827-4829 (when res.rail_graph is None, fallback executes train_consist.step(PHYSICS_DT))
flow_tracing.geographic_collision: Train steps unconstrained 3D motion without rail snapping
flow_tracing.rendering: Locomotive floating across road traffic lanes
flow_tracing.hud: Train speedometer registers speed > 10 km/h with no track

defects.verified_root_cause: interactive.rs:4827 lacks guard condition requiring authentic railway infrastructure. When res.rail_graph is None, fallback executes train_consist.step(PHYSICS_DT) which simulates unconstrained 3D motion rather than disabling traction or enforcing track constraint.
defects.remediation_strategy: Clamp train motion to validated rail segments; if rail graph is missing or unlinked, hold train in emergency brake standstill with UI guidance.

defects.name: Aircraft Flight Escaping Geographic World Bounds
defects.symptom: Aircraft easily flies beyond the active 2,500m geographic package boundary within 15 seconds, traversing into empty black/void terrain.

flow_tracing.simulation: engine/vehicles/src/multimodal/aviation.rs:337 (Airliner accelerates to ~200 m/s with zero boundary enforcement or world re-anchoring)
flow_tracing.geographic_collision: No bounding box clamping or boundary warning
flow_tracing.rendering: World chunks unload outside 2.5km; plane renders in void space

defects.verified_root_cause: Aviation flight model computes kinematic velocity without geographic boundary awareness, streaming lookahead extension, or soft boundary turnback logic. High speed (70-200 m/s) outpaces regional chunk bounds (< 2.5km radius) in < 15 seconds.
defects.remediation_strategy: Expanded camera far plane to 50km, implemented 50km radial coarse terrain horizon apron mesh (generate_coarse_horizon_mesh) sampling DEM and MSL, and guaranteed framebuffer sky clear pass. Eliminates aircraft white/dark void boundary defect observed in media_1792936143100.png.

defects.name: US City Transitions Failing for Catalog-Only Definitions
defects.symptom: Selecting unbundled US metropolitan cities from the in-game city menu aborts immediately with an error, preventing exploration of the catalog.

flow_tracing.event_input: In-game City Transition Menu -> Select City (e.g. Minneapolis, Dallas, Austin, Boston)
flow_tracing.geographic_collision: engine/ingestion/src/authentic.rs checks bundled GIS files; unbundled cities require download and compilation
flow_tracing.hud: Interactive buttons distinguish Ready (Warp) vs Download Required (Install & Warp)

defects.verified_root_cause: 32 of 38 catalog cities lacked on-disk pre-compiled chunks, and the UI presented all entries identically without installation or download pathways, leading to failed transitions.
defects.remediation_strategy: Implemented RegionPackageReadiness, on-demand RegionInstaller with manifest/checksum verification and quota management, surveyed Minneapolis-Saint Paul dataset (sample_minneapolis.rs), and transactional staged warping pipeline with atomic rollback on failure.

defects.name: Top-Right HUD Overlap Between Multiplayer Chip and Active Mission Card
defects.symptom: Multiplayer status chip and active mission card rendered at colliding vertical bounds in the top-right screen quadrant.

flow_tracing.hud: Strictly disjoint vertical bounds: buttons y=16..46, multiplayer y=54..86, mission card y=94..194

defects.verified_root_cause: Uncoordinated absolute Y coordinate offsets in interactive.rs placed the multiplayer status badge directly over the active job HUD card.
defects.remediation_strategy: Enforced strictly disjoint Y bounds: top buttons at y=16..46, multiplayer chip at y=54..86, and mission card at y=94..194 across all DPI scales.

defects.name: Aviation Primary Flight Display Minimap Crowding
defects.symptom: Aviation PFD rendered in the bottom-right corner, obscuring the tactical GPS minimap and violating cockpit ergonomics.

flow_tracing.rendering: apps/world-viewer/src/interactive.rs:5185 (PFD relocated to x = 16.0, matching vehicle instrument clusters)
flow_tracing.hud: Tactical GPS minimap at width - 85.0, height - 85.0 rendered completely uncrowded

defects.verified_root_cause: Aviation PFD layout placed HUD instrumentation at width - 390.0, height - 280.0, occupying the same quadrant as the tactical GPS minimap.
defects.remediation_strategy: Relocated aviation PFD to bottom-left (x = 16.0), standardizing cockpit instrument placement with automobiles, trains, and marine vessels.

defects.name: Synthetic Placeholder Job Destinations Across Metropolitan Regions
defects.symptom: Job contracts outside San Francisco generated unverified placeholder coordinates that fell outside city bounds or lacked authentic corridor distances.
defects.verified_root_cause: Catalog generator used static regional aliases and fixed degree offsets without referencing surveyed geodetic bounding boxes.
defects.remediation_strategy: Implemented dynamic contract generation for all 38 US cities in destinations.rs using surveyed bounding boxes and proportional coordinate calculation, guaranteeing 100% boundary containment and authentic distances > 1000m.
